title: Exclude combination-carrier correction programs on the selected P104 word (no new κ)
body:
## Result

PR6045 left chart-local combination carriers unresolved after excluding individual carrier fields. On the selected PR6030 word, exactly **2 of its 4,033 leak classes** have a combination carrier, but **no class can be legalized by any finite program of combination-carrier updates** in the fixed original event/chart schedule.

- **4,009 classes:** `R M^-1 S e_p = e_p` gives an input collision. Overwriting the helper destroys information needed by the outside outputs, so no later algorithm using only the available scalar state can repair them.
- **22 classes:** information survives globally, but no chart-local combination carrier occurs in the original continuation.
- **2 classes:** at cuts 13637/13639, helper 572/chart 595, `field778-field572` is the retained-copy carrier. A dynamic residual-line/output-span invariant covers every permitted correction window: canceling the outside leakage necessarily erases all final public dependence on the new helper.

The correction class permits arbitrary finite atomic updates `field_r += q*(a fields)` with source and target in one existing chart and `a R_t=0`. It includes multi-source combination-carrier updates and permits dynamically generated carriers. The prefix, original events, chart schedule and storage are fixed. General non-carrier edits in the 24 information-retaining cases, new routes/storage, changed prefixes and non-unit injections remain open.

This is a scoped written proof with exact finite certificates, **not a new κ or a complete multiplication theorem**. Only `research/p104-combination-carrier-boundary/` is added.

## Evidence

The source-bound verifier reuses Nick Petalas's unmodified PR6040 census, retained by JosieElliston in PR6045, to define the class domain. The prefix/suffix interpreter, information test, residual reduction and controls are new.

- All 4,033 exact information tests; 196 chart-kernel computations/1,814 class-chart checks classify the 24 residual cases.
- Both positive witnesses, all 15 active windows and 90 target projection/full-column span checks. A five-dimensional output span has an outside-coordinate minor of determinant −2.
- 4,410 decoding cases and 3,780 endpoint/pivot cases agree with separate exact algebraic oracles; 154 small matrices test the production kernel. Every scalar opcode and four implementation mutations are checked.
- A separate AI-assisted scan with touched-chart pruning disabled made 61,838 checks and obtained the same 2/22 residual classification. That second full scan is local corroboration, not a registered second engine.
- CPython 3.12.14 normal and optimized registered replays, metadata/source pins, committed bytes/modes/source-history and official export integrity pass. Both direct modes also pass from a read-only export with Git absent from PATH, identical output and unchanged files.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-combination-carrier-boundary/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/p104-combination-carrier-boundary/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-combination-carrier-boundary
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-combination-carrier-boundary --check-source-history --check-modes
```

The read-only export replay took 18.15 seconds normally and 17.89 seconds with optimization. Registered commands have 120-second limits. The information transcript digest is `d4a1ba5ddfc72cdc34425f3849b2a00128fad3833ef8c6ab04a905181c8e748c`. Hosted CI is separate from these local checks and has not yet certified this branch.

## Sources, scope and coordination

Pulled canonical main first and refreshed before publication: `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, priority revision 8. Selected κ remains 0.003125804. Task `p104-side-correction` and its full original card are retained in [TASK.json](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4d629cf0d20a06d65b3ba0cf3a34e105128725e3/research/p104-combination-carrier-boundary/TASK.json), with scope explicitly changed to PR6045's released scalar question. [Advance claim and canonical status](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19233068).

Exact predecessor heads: PR6045 `23abc00773a72d8e2b4e733b46c453b0f71f6368`; PR6040 `1889253fdbfd37e0f984ac412cf0ada4f36fa676`. The imported census bytes are preserved in this branch's own ancestry before the checker commit, so no cached pending-PR history is required. The selected word hash is checked before execution.

Live all-state PR searches and recent handoffs found no matching successor. Adjacent 6043 audits the selected application, 6033 prices an extra carrier, and the newer 6061/6062 concern connector templates and stock accounting. Local overlap coverage was incomplete (41/8,348 notes; no usable remote helper cache), supplemented by connector searches and the live board. No exhaustive novelty guarantee is claimed.

Native maps, normalization, ownership after changed operations, pairing, caller, compiler, precision/tape and the full paid/ordinary/outer invoice remain outside scope. The five selected framework assumptions remain; no selected cold replay, Lean or Docker was needed or run. Agent proof reviews and finite verification do not constitute independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.

[Open next questions](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4d629cf0d20a06d65b3ba0cf3a34e105128725e3/research/p104-combination-carrier-boundary/README.md#open-next-questions): propose a concrete non-carrier correction in one of the 24 residual cases and verify its entire symbolic map, legal lifetimes and complete cost. Repeating carrier-only searches in this fixed model cannot help.

Credit JosieElliston for PR6045's question/model, Nick Petalas for PR6040's census, Matarener for PR5994, flyingviper for PR5718, Ali Romman for PR5599/P104 lineage, DreamingOfClouds for PR5907/6030, and their retained predecessors. New work by **apoursh** with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate subagent derivation/review. Apache-2.0.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way. **Blast radius:** one isolated, opt-in research package. Shared code, frozen predecessors and the selected record are unchanged.
